title: Remediation Credit for Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) Removals in Seller Performance Standing Top-Performer Relief
content:
**Credit.** The remediation credit is the disposal credit of 1 point for a seller whose Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment billed a disposal removal fee in the last six whole calendar months, the return credit of 0.5 point for a seller whose enrollment billed no disposal removal fee but a return-to-seller removal fee in that period, and nothing for every other seller.

Under Seller Performance Standing the credit is added to the top-performer relief points before the sum is rounded down to a whole point, the top-performer cap then applying to the result.

## Records read

The removal fee entries billed on the seller's Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment, each showing its removal type — disposal or return to seller — and its billing date. A fee lies in the last six whole calendar months when fewer than six whole months have passed from its billing date to the handling date, counted by calendar date.

## Decision table

| Disposal removal fee in the period | Return-to-seller removal fee in the period | Remediation credit |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | any | 1 point |
| none | one or more | 0.5 point |
| none | none | nothing |
| no enrollment | — | nothing |

## Boundary (hypothetical handling date 20 September)

- A disposal fee billed on 20 March: six whole months have passed, so it is outside the period.
- A disposal fee billed on 21 March: five whole months have passed, so it is inside the period and the credit is 1 point.

**Worked figure.** Relief points 1.8 with a return credit of 0.5 make 2.3, rounded down to 2.
